title: Best Ars3nal Script
features:
Kill Farm
Auto Kill Farm — teleports you into melee range of the nearest enemy
Auto-TP on Kill — teleports to next enemy after each kill

Movement
Fly — full 6DOF flight with WASD + Space / LCtrl, toggle with [T]
Noclip — walk through all solid geometry
Infinite Jump — re-jumps on every jump request
Double Jump — one extra mid-air jump
Walk Speed slider — 16 to 300
Jump Power slider — 50 to 500
Fly Speed slider — 10 to 300

Visual
Rainbow ESP — animated rainbow Highlight outline on all enemies
Chams — AlwaysOnTop highlight on your own character and arms
Custom Skybox — replaces the game skybox

Utility
Anti-AFK — sends a virtual input every 4 minutes to prevent kick
Server Hop — auto teleports to a new server when player count drops to 2 or below

Keybinds
[INSERT] — toggle the GUI window open/closed
[F] — toggle Fly
